core_obligations: K is the filtered union of countable subfields; descend X -> S and Y -> S to a countable subfield k.
Enumerate all pairs (S_{0,i} -> S_0, h_{0,i}) over k up to isomorphism; base change them to K.
For a closed point s with fibre isomorphism h_s, descend to a finitely generated subalgebra A: the diagram property and the base-changed isomorphism place (s, h_s) into the enumeration.
proof_roadmap: Descent to k, enumeration, then the subalgebra descent with the displayed commutative diagram.
difficulty_reason: Cofiltered limit descent with a countability enumeration and a finitely generated subalgebra argument; multi-lemma coordination.
